Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA ------

For the Petitioners : Mr. Kaushal Kishore Mishra, Advocate For the State : Mr. Fahad Allam,
Addl.P.P Mr. V.K. Vashistha, S.P.P. Order No.03 Dated- 15.07.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Both bail applications arising out of same FIR, have been heard together.

3. The petitioners have been made accused in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.
26 of 2024 registered under sections 414, 419, 420, 467, 468 471 and 120B of Indian Penal Code.

entities.text:
Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.
26 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. As per FIR, allegation is that on 22.04.2024, on the basis of secret information about cybercrime being committed by the petitioners, a raid was conducted and the petitioners were apprehended with number of mobile phones along with SIM Cards and ATM Cards, Voter Cards, Passbooks etc.,
which were being used in cybercrime.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case on the basis of suspicion.

There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioners and no money transactions have been made through the seized articles and even no victim has turned out with allegation of cyber fraud committed by the petitioners.

Petitioners undertake to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
The petitioners are languishing in judicial custody since 23.04.2024 without any rhymes and reasons.
Hence the petitioners may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text:
Learned Addl. P.P. and learned S.P.P. appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioners.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioners coupled with materials available on record and period of custody of the petitioners, I am inclined to release the above named petitioners, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners named above, are directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Jamtara in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 26 of 2024 with condition that petitioners shall appear physically on each and every date during the trial of case till its conclusion unless their physical appearance is dispensed with for sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned trial court and with further condition that petitioners shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
